def execute_draw_final(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Draw extracts stored magic from opponents or draw points for later casting or junctioning.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    item = resolve_owned_eligible_item_or_stock(actor,target)
    validate_slot_weight_and_binding_rules(actor,item)
    equip_store_recall_or_convert(item, selected_action)

    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
